title: AA Shared-Transport Envelope
description: The local shared-store transport (toolkit/sync/transport.js#createSharedTransport) — same device, multiple apps, zero accounts. Both directions share ENVELOPE_VERSION=1 but carry different payloads, distinguished by which fields are present: the EXPORT envelope (toolkit stores at key EXPORT_PREFIX+appId='aa.shared.export.'+appId, read via readExport(appId)) carries appId+abilityModel; the INBOX-ENTRY envelope (appended to the array at INBOX_KEY='aa.shared.inbox', posted via postInsight) carries sourceAppId+sentAt+insight. This schema's validator subset has no oneOf, so it validates the union shape — see protocol/README.md for exactly which fields belong to which flavor.

appId.description: EXPORT flavor only. The granted app this exported slice belongs to.

abilityModel.description: EXPORT flavor only. The AbilityModel already filtered to the grant's scopes (filterAbilityModelByScopes) — never the full model, never freeText/confidence.

sourceAppId.description: INBOX-ENTRY flavor only. The posting app — must hold an active grant or drainInbox refuses the entry with reason 'no-grant'.

insight.description: INBOX-ENTRY flavor only. Same insight shape as one entry of insight-outbox.schema.json#/properties/insights/items.
